responsibility: Implements the core mutable callgraph and symbol-table behavior for GCC interprocedural optimization. This file owns the runtime operations on cgraph and symtab nodes and edges: creating, removing, querying, and updating calls, references, aliases, clone/version metadata, event hooks, and per-node availability or address-comparison properties. It is the main execution-side companion to cgraph.h, providing utilities used throughout IPA and LTO such as function-version tracking, edge frequency helpers, alias walks, thunk/clone state queries, and global symtab lifecycle reset logic.
same_name_distinction: Implements the out-of-line behavior behind cgraph.h’s core callgraph/symtab types: mutable node and edge operations, hook dispatch, version-info tables, alias walks, frequency helpers, and global cgraph state reset. Unlike gcc/cgraph.h, it is the execution-side code rather than the shared type/interface definitions and inline helpers.
